title: Approve MVP scope
decision: MVP consists of features FEAT-001 to FEAT-012 as specified in docs/04-prd/OUTPUT.md: free, Telegram-only, Uzbek-only, sized for a pilot of about ten shops; billing, SMS fallback and multiple sellers are deferred
context: Positioning B was approved in DEC-004; the MVP is scoped to test whether customer acknowledgement and Telegram reminders improve repayment and whether entry is fast enough to replace the notebook
chosen_option: Free Telegram-only MVP with acknowledgement, reminders and pilot measurement
rationale: Smallest scope that tests the unproven differentiation (EVID-019) while respecting data localization (EVID-027) and avoiding unresolved payment rules (EVID-028)
